ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.05:1; the fluke surface is dominated by low-intensity black pixels with high-intensity white clusters isolated to the distal tips and sparse linear markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black pigmentation across >95% of the fluke area. High-intensity (white) geometric blobs are localized at the extreme lateral coordinates of both lobes. Sparse, multi-directional white linear pixel strings are detected on the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 75-80 degrees and a vertical bounding-box depth of approximately 60 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular trailing boundary with high-frequency serrations; pixel amplitude of valleys ranges from 5 to 20 pixels relative to local maxima; serrations are more pronounced on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broadly convex curve from the median notch to the mid-lobe, transitioning to a slight posterior recurve at the extreme distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two high-density clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast white pixel groups (barnacle colonies) located at the lateral-most tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, non-parallel white linear trajectories (scratches) visible on the left lobe surface, ranging from 15 to 50 pixels in length.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle encrustation on both lateral tips; one prominent horizontal white linear mark approximately 50 pixels in length situated on the left lobe near the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: A subtle vertical column of higher-intensity grey pixels extending from the fluke-to-peduncle junction towards the median notch apex.
